verdict.rationale: Kit explicitly documents bulk processing support for common use cases like creating subscribers via OAuth, plus broadcast sends to segments/tags and webhook-driven automation, giving a real bulk-operations foundation. However, bulk support is explicitly limited to 'some common use cases' rather than general-purpose bulk operations across arbitrary items, and there's no evidence of bulk update/delete or bulk tagging APIs. missing for 10: broader bulk endpoint coverage beyond subscriber creation, independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk operation limits and performance.
